nodes.name: Background Processing.md
nodes.summary: Qoder wiki overview of the Setura Hospital OS background processing system covering job queue architecture, worker orchestration with retry and dead-letter handling, cron scheduling for minute-level and nightly tasks, and patterns for new job creation, error handling, prioritization, and observability.

nodes.name: Cron Scheduling.md
nodes.summary: Qoder wiki page describing the Setura cron scheduling system, including the minute-level and nightly orchestrators, secret-based authentication, ordered nightly pipeline (token carry-forward, analytics rollups, SLA, retention, partition scheduling), and per-step error isolation.

nodes.name: Error Handling & Retries.md
nodes.summary: Qoder wiki page detailing how the background processing system categorizes transient vs permanent errors, applies exponential backoff, routes exhausted jobs to the dead letter queue, and coordinates with the typed error hierarchy, worker leases, idempotency helpers, and metrics.

nodes.name: Job Queue Architecture.md
nodes.summary: Qoder wiki page describing the database-backed job queue: job_queue schema, enqueue/claim/complete/fail/reclaim stored procedures, worker leases, prioritization, batching, idempotency, dead-letter handling, and queue metrics snapshots.

nodes.name: Monitoring & Observability.md
nodes.summary: Qoder wiki page describing the background processing observability stack: structured logging with correlation IDs, per-request metrics, tracing spans, queue and system health snapshots, alert thresholds, and the monitoring-health-check endpoint for dashboards.

nodes.name: Worker Orchestration.md
nodes.summary: Qoder wiki page describing worker registration, heartbeat/lease management, crash recovery, concurrency-safe job claiming via FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, job execution lifecycle, graceful shutdown, horizontal scaling, timeouts, and cleanup procedures for the background worker fleet.
